summary: 80s synth production: gated-reverb snare, chorus on everything, bright analog pads, wide and glossy
body: Gated reverb on the snare: a big short room cut off abruptly.
Chorus and stereo width on pads, bass and leads; bright, little saturation; delays in 8ths or dotted 8ths.
No chain for it yet: build it with Reverb (short decay, high wet) on the drums and a chorus-like detune on the synths.
